feeds.title: The happy Quitter!
feeds.description: I started writing when I gave up smoking, started blogging, because the subject was important to me -until then I didn't even know I liked writing. That's why my blog is called 'The Happy Quitter' because it all begun when I gave up smoking after 35 years. There are some tough subjects, that I would like to write about. This section of my blog might interest you if you just gave up smoking as well; or if you decided to do so in the future. There are humorous stories that I would like to share.
